title: Soul Calibur's fighters
body: All 19 fighters from Soul Calibur, the little figures the game shows on the VMU, five poses each, decompressed from the US disc with the game's own routine. They play at the site's default speed until their in-game timing is measured.

title: Sakura Taisen 3, with scrolling banners
body: From the Japanese Sakura Taisen 3 disc: the title screen with its logo intro, the crest, and four expressions each for Erica, Glycine, Coquelicot, Lobelia, Hanabi and Ogami. Also the 23 special attack banners the game scrolls across the VMU in battle, stored as the one strip the game slides through the screen and played at its speed. They download as that strip, or as an animation.

title: Shenmue II, straight from the disc
body: Every VMU screen in the Japanese Shenmue II: the title screen, loading, saving and resume screens in Japanese and English, and the battle screens.

title: Power Stone and Power Stone 2, straight from the disc
body: Every VMU screen in both games: the Access screens for Power Stone and Power Stone 2, and the Power Stone 2 title screen. The Power Stone title screen already in the archive matches the disc exactly.

title: Project Justice, straight from the disc
body: Every VMU screen in the Japanese Moero! Justice Gakuen: the Japanese title screen, and the Access screen under both the Japanese and Project Justice logos.

title: Bangaioh, straight from the disc
body: Every VMU screen in the Japanese Bakuretsu Muteki Bangaioh, played with the timing from the game's own code: the Japanese title screen and the Riki and Mami loops. Four more the game never shows are marked Unused: the Treasure logo, a second Riki and Mami loop each, and an animated Continue?.

title: Berserk, straight from the disc
body: Every Puck screen, extracted from the Sword of the Berserk disc and played with the timing read from the game's own code: seven new animations, the NG screen, the US title screen, and Do not touch now animated in full. Six screens the game never shows are marked Unused.

title: Bangai-O
body: The title screen from Treasure's shooter Bangai-O, and its animated robot.

title: Ryo Hazuki comes to life
body: Shenmue's Ryo Hazuki is now animated. You can also pick a game next to the search box to see only its screens.

title: Carrier
body: The title screen from Jaleco's survival horror Carrier.

title: Sega Tetris
body: The title screen, the memory card screens and the full cast of animated characters, from Bowie to Panna-Panna.

title: Title screens and the first animations
body: Title screens from Blue Stinger, Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver, Marvel vs. Capcom 2, Power Stone, Rez and Shenmue, the Dreamcast menu smile and screens from Berserk, including Puck. Animated screens now play on hover and download as GIF or animated SVG. The Crazy Taxi title screen is animated too.

title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater
body: All 35 screens: the title screen, loading and saving, and every reaction from "Rad" to "U suck".

title: The archive opens
body: The first 128 screens: the whole Puyo Pop Fever cast, Sonic Adventure and Sonic Adventure 2, and title screens from Crazy Taxi, Ikaruga, Jet Set Radio, Project Justice, Sonic Shuffle and Soul Calibur.
